title: Texas Standard for Oct. 23, 2026: Gina Hinojosa makes her case for Texas governor
summary: What once looked like a long-shot challenge to Gov. Greg Abbott has tightened as Election Day approaches. Democratic nominee Gina Hinojosa discusses what she says has changed in the race,...
content: What once looked like a long-shot challenge to Gov. Greg Abbott has tightened as Election Day approaches. Democratic nominee Gina Hinojosa discusses what she says has changed in the race, her approach to affordability, border security and state spending, and how she would govern alongside a Republican-controlled Legislature.
